### 1 — Scene
A mixed leafy salad with chickpeas, sliced vegetables, dark olives, and a few pale fruit-like wedges.

### 2 — Vessel
A square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods appear to be mixed salad leaves, chickpeas, cucumber, red onion, shredded carrot, black olives, and pale apple/pear-like slices. A light sheen suggests a small amount of dressing; its composition is uncertain.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares below partition the food-covered region rather than double-counting overlapping ingredients. Dressing coats these foods, so adds no separate footprint.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leaves | 30% | 159 × 2 = 318 ml | 0.15 | 48 | 20 | 10 |
| Cooked chickpeas | 12% | 64 × 1.2 = 77 ml | 0.8 | 61 | 164 | 100 |
| Cucumber | 7% | 37 × 1 = 37 ml | 0.6 | 22 | 15 | 3 |
| Red onion | 3% | 16 × 0.6 = 10 ml | 0.6 | 6 | 40 | 2 |
| Shredded carrot | 1% | 5 × 1.2 = 6 ml | 0.6 | 4 | 41 | 2 |
| Black olives | 2% | 11 × 1 = 11 ml | 0.7 | 8 | 116 | 9 |
| Apple/pear-like slices | 4% | 21 × 0.8 = 17 ml | 0.65 | 11 | 55 | 6 |
| Light oil-based dressing | Overlapping | Approximately 5 ml | 1.0 | 5 | 700 | 35 |

**Coverage check:** 30 + 12 + 7 + 3 + 1 + 2 + 4 = **59%**, consistent with the substantial empty portion of the plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **about 165 g and 170 kcal**. This is plausible for a loosely piled salad covering roughly three-fifths of a dinner plate. Chickpeas and dressing contribute most of the energy; dressing quantity is the largest uncertainty.
